import sys

def good(p, n, i):
    for j in range(n):
        if j == i:
            continue
        for k in range(j + 1, n):
            if k == i:
                continue
            dot = (p[j][0] - p[i][0]) * (p[k][0] - p[i][0]) \
                + (p[j][1] - p[i][1]) * (p[k][1] - p[i][1]) \
                + (p[j][2] - p[i][2]) * (p[k][2] - p[i][2]) \
                + (p[j][3] - p[i][3]) * (p[k][3] - p[i][3]) \
                + (p[j][4] - p[i][4]) * (p[k][4] - p[i][4])
            if dot > 0:
                return False
    return True

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return
    points = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for d in range(5):
            points[i][d] = int(next(it))
    ret = []
    for i in range(n):
        if good(points, n, i):
            ret.append(i + 1)
    print(len(ret))
    for x in ret:
        print(x)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
